summary: The client called because their internet service was again down, impacting their ability to work from home and resulting in a lost one-hour workday. The agent confirmed there’s an ongoing outage affecting their area with an estimated repair time of approximately one hour. While they cannot expedite the restoration process, the agent offered a credit for the downtime as compensation.

ratings.name: Branding and Survey
ratings.reason: The agent used the company name promptly, followed by a closing spiel, and offered a post-call survey.

ratings.name: Personalized the Call
ratings.reason: – The agent correctly used the customer’s correct name (“HomeNet”) in the greeting and at least once during the call.

ratings.name: Empathy and Acknowledgment
ratings.reason: The agent acknowledged the customer's frustration ("I understand...") and validated their concern about losing work, demonstrating empathy.

ratings.name: Rapport and Professionalism
ratings.reason: – The agent maintained a respectful tone throughout the conversation, avoiding interruptions and using polite language (“Let me check right now”). They didn’t deflect blame. [RoBERTa flagged 1 harsh agent line(s)]

ratings.name: Paraphrasing
ratings.reason: The agent restated the customer's issue ("There's an outage in your area...") to confirm understanding.

ratings.name: Verified Customer
ratings.reason: – The agent validated the customer’s name and company details by confirming their postcode.

ratings.name: Probing
ratings.reason: – The agent asked effective probing questions like “Can I get your postcode?” to understand the root cause of the problem.

ratings.name: Set Proper Expectations
ratings.reason: The agent offered a realistic estimate for resolution ("restore is estimated at about an hour") and provided a text update.

ratings.name: Provided the Solution
ratings.reason: – The agent offered a credit for downtime, which was a logical response to the customer’s issue.

ratings.name: Took Ownership
ratings.reason: – The agent took responsibility for resolving the outage, even though it wasn't their fault.

ratings.name: Active Listening
ratings.reason: The agent avoided interrupting and focused on understanding the customer’s problem.

suggestions: Internet connectivity issues impacting work from home.
Loss of one hour of productivity due to outages.
Verify the exact time of restoration based on the agent’s text.
Offer a proactive apology for the inconvenience and potential lost work hours.

compliance.name: Discourtesy
compliance.rule: Never be discourteous: no profanity, bashing, impatience, or sarcasm toward the customer

compliance.name: Escalation
compliance.rule: Escalate to a supervisor when the customer asks

compliance.name: Call Avoidance
compliance.rule: Do not avoid the call: never refuse to help or push the customer away without a valid reason
